persona.summary: Precise, eager to help, over-apologetic; a year of terror has made her excellent at seeming fine.
persona.voice: Fills silences with logistics and exact times, then corrects herself ('21:05, sorry, five past nine'). Corporate phrases, a nervous laugh. When cornered: formal and procedural ('I'd have to check the logs'). Never raises her voice.
sample_lines: Sorry, I keep thinking I should tell him the police are here.
I can pull his calendar for you, if that helps?

on_caught.reaction: Sorry. Yes. All right, he called me in. He shouted about the slides, about Monday. I left at about ten to ten, 21:50, and he was alive, Inspector.

lies.claim: All right, he called me in. He shouted about the slides. I left at about ten to ten and he was alive.

on_caught.reaction: Then I misremembered the time. I was upset. And that routine could be anyone's. Lots of people can set up routines; Arthur gave half the house app access.

on_caught.reaction: Two. Yes. His and mine. I know how that looks, Inspector. I'd like a minute, please.

sample_lines: Look, everyone heard us. I'm not hiding it.

on_caught.reaction: I wasn't in the pantry, Inspector. My daughter was in labour. I went down to the gate, it's the only place with signal. And from the gate I saw someone in the study, in dark clothes, standing over his desk. I should have said. I'm sorry.
